title: Implement persistent Journal storage and restart recovery
goal: Implement the storage adapter selected by the durable Journal contract and demonstrate coherent session recovery after process restart.
scope: Implement only the adapter and assembly changes admitted by DEV-0004.
Preserve atomic expected-revision append, exact event order, schema versions, and typed failures.
Verify restart, concurrent writer, interrupted write, and corrupt-state behavior through kernel consumers.
acceptance: The selected adapter satisfies every invariant and failure case in the reviewed durable Journal contract.
A session opened by one process can be read coherently after restart without weakening kernel projection validation.
Failed or stale appends do not expose partial history, and deliberately corrupt state is not reported as an empty or valid session.
User-facing documentation states storage ownership, location, lifetime, migration, and recovery limits.
context: This task is intentionally unscheduled until DEV-0004 selects and reviews the contract and storage approach.

history.note: Storage implemented as SQLite journal (SqliteJournal); review cycle complete.
